purpose: Isolated experimental layer for testing business hypotheses and interaction prototypes without silently changing accepted Website Ventures decisions, assets or customer data.

sourceHierarchy.rule: Evidence can promote a lab hypothesis into HQ; a lab hypothesis never overwrites HQ by itself.

guardrails: No prospect calls, emails, DMs or form submissions from the Lab without Joey explicitly requesting outreach.
No fake reviews, client projects, certifications, staff identity or performance claims.
No paid Higgsfield/video generation credits are spent from autonomous Lab work.
Accepted Website Lab variants are never overwritten without first preserving the prior version as an archive.
Do not scale to students, salespeople or provinces before the first delivery and sales loop is proven.

interactionContract: Start with the tablet resting on the same large pale stone.
Scroll lifts the tablet diagonally and rotates it toward upright with smooth continuous interpolation.
At the peak the tablet fills most, but not all, of the viewport so its physical edges remain visible.
The tablet screen becomes real HTML and shows coded Website Ventures demos rather than generated fake website screenshots.
Showcase section must communicate multiple visual worlds rather than one template repeated three times.
Ads / product motion must be presented as a capability demo unless and until it becomes a genuine client case.
Configurator is transparent about test pricing and does not masquerade as a binding quotation.
Booking/contact is optional; users can always continue to the ending.
The visual story ends by closing/settling the device back on the same stone.

weekSprint.primaryOutcome: Own agency site visually strong and coherent, three distinct example websites represented in it, and at least one product/ad motion example available.
weekSprint.assetWindow: Approximately four remaining days of the current Higgsfield Unlimited period per Joey's estimate; use as a production sprint, not a random asset dump.
weekSprint.salesGate: Once own site plus three strong examples are good enough to show, do not build a fourth fictional demo before at least one real person has seen the offer or a real external test project has started.
weekSprint.reuseTarget: Roughly 70% reusable underlying system while front-end color, copy, hero, motion, composition and information rhythm can vary substantially.

evidenceGates.question: Does the finished presentation create a genuine wow reaction and a serious conversation?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Fix the offer/demo before adding more fictional showcase volume.

evidenceGates.question: Can Joey repeatedly close, deliver and support the founding offer while customers remain happy?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Do not hire or expand geography yet.

evidenceGates.question: Do customers report better trust, traction, conversion quality or other real business value?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Do not sell unsupported performance claims; improve product and measurement.

scaleGates: Delivery repeatedly at or below roughly 6 hours after complete intake.
At least three genuine customers/cases with usable feedback or proof.
A sales process with enough repeated observations to estimate conversion rather than guess it.
A reusable component/visual system so another builder can follow a standard without degrading quality.
